title: The Taxonomy of the Untranslated Joke
core_theme: The linguistic border control between family history and modern spaces.
narrative_spec: Take a deep look into humor, In particular its fragility among different people and places

title: The Liturgy of the Divided Ledger
core_theme: The economic and emotional gravity of the immigrant remittance.
narrative_spec: Set the scene at a local wire-transfer terminal or a digital banking application at midnight, where a first-generation professional splits their salary to send funds back to a home country. If you do not relate try your best, its a practice.

title: The Architecture of the Restrictive Vestment
core_theme: The physical containment of traditional gender expectations.
narrative_spec: Examine the feeling of another cultures clothing, perhaps on your own body or someone elses

title: The Geometry of the Passport Queue
core_theme: The arbitration of human worth through international paperwork.
narrative_spec: Analyze the physical experience of standing in a state border line or visa interview room, holding documents that declare a citizenship status under scrutiny.

title: The Blueprint of the Non-Binary Loom
core_theme: The navigation of spaces that require binary gender performance.
narrative_spec: Focus on the interior friction of walking into an institutional, religious, or traditional space where the architecture, rituals, and languages are violently divided down a gendered centerline.

title: The Litany of the First-Generation Mortgage
core_theme: The permanent financialization of an ancestral dream of earth.
narrative_spec: A descendant signs the closing paperwork for an expensive piece of real estate in an affluent suburb—a milestone their sharecropping or refugee ancestors could not conceive.

title: The Interrogation of the Tokenized Resume
core_theme: The corporate monetization of identity for marketing metrics.
narrative_spec: can you functionally transform words into a poem that captures the necessity of diversity?

title: The Geometry of the Unshared Heirloom
core_theme: The material burden of a history that cannot be explained.
narrative_spec: think of the moments that allowed you to arrive here. Poem about it

title: The Protocol of the Intercultural Marriage
core_theme: The negotiation of two distinct ancestral mythologies at a single table.
narrative_spec: see if you can turn the intercultural experience of romantic love into a poem... it doesn't have to be about love.

title: The Calibration of the Academic Voice
core_theme: The intellectual extraction of class memory for theory validation.
narrative_spec: attempt to use a poem to bridge the gap between generations. Powerful if you must but gentle may win the day.

title: The Last Accord at the Heritage Camp
core_theme: The performance of identity for youth cultural camps.
narrative_spec: Can you capture culture in a unique way?
